comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel reported year-over-year revenue declines in their respective fiscal years 2024, driven by specific segment weaknesses. AMD's Gaming segment revenue dropped significantly by 58% to $2.6 billion, primarily due to lower semi-custom product revenue. Similarly, Intel's total revenue decreased by 2% to $53.1 billion, a decline attributed to lower Intel Foundry revenue and 'all other' revenue, partially offset by higher Intel Products revenue. While both companies faced headwinds in specific legacy or cyclical areas (Gaming for AMD, Foundry/Other for Intel), they both experienced overall top-line contraction or stagnation compared to the prior year.
